conceptZh: 雪是冬天從天上飄下的白色冰晶
object: a bespectacled lab mouse, beakers and a bouncing snowball
morph: a bouncing snowball hits beakers and each hit drops a stroke of 雪
creativeAngle: 科學家老鼠的雪球彈來彈去，每次撞一下掉一筆，結尾做出雪人。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 雪 (snow). Lead: a bespectacled mouse in a tiny white coat among fizzing beakers. Moment 1 (0-1.6s): he pours a bubbling potion that freezes into a snowball, bounces; the voice says 雪 as it clinks off a flask. Moment 2 (1.6-3.3s): the ball ricochets around beakers; each hit drops a blue stroke from above; on the second 雪 the last one lands and 雪 shines. Moment 3 (3.3-5.2s): the mouse rolls two more snowballs; as the voice says 雪人 they stack into a round snowman with a carrot nose that sneezes the carrot into the mouse's glasses. Moment 4 (5.2-8s): glyph still; the snowman and mouse high-five, small snowflakes drifting down beside them. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "雪、雪、雪人" (ㄒㄩㄝˇ、ㄒㄩㄝˇ、ㄒㄩㄝˇ ㄖㄣˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 雪, drawn as saturated solid icy blue strokes on a warm light gray-beige background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
